paragraphs.text: # 竹居 · dsh-tjing-reading
An EPUB / PDF / Kindle / plain-text reader that lives in the DSH sidebar — WeChat Read style typogra
phy, table of contents, bookmarks, highlights and reading-progress memory, select-to-translate, plus
an AI assistant that answers only from passages retrieved from the book you have open.
**English** · 简体中文
> Verified on DSH 0.2.1 – 0.2.2 (desktop and `web` profile) · Plain JavaScript, no install-time buil
ied on DSH 0.2.1 – 0.2.2 (desktop and `web` profile) · Plain JavaScript, no install-time build · MIT
## Supported formats
| Format | Notes |

| EPUB 2 / 3 | Spine, NCX/nav TOC, images, themes and adjustable typography. |
| PDF | 22 zoom steps

, continuous scrolling, first-page cover thumbnails. |
| MOBI / AZW3 (KF8) | DRM-free Kindle files o

nly. Combo files open the KF8 half automatically. |
| TXT | UTF-8, UTF-16 (LE/BE with BOM) and GB180
30 are detected automatically; chapters are detected from heading patterns (`Chapter 1`, `第一章`, etc.
) and can be jumped to from the contents panel. |
What is **not** supported: DRM-protected MOBI/AZW3 files (no DRM removal), KFX, and `.azw` files. Im
port Kindle books with their correct `.mobi` or `.azw3` extension; their Palm database headers are v
alidated before parsing.
## Features
- **Import** EPUB, PDF, MOBI/AZW3 or TXT through the file picker, or drag & drop into the bookshelf.
- **Reader** with WeChat Read style typography: font size, line height, page margins, and multiple
themes (default, green, parchment, dark). The PDF paper colour follows the theme too; the zoom perce
ntage stays fixed relative to the width captured when the book was opened, so folding the sidebar ne

ver rescales the page.
- **Navigation**: table of contents, chapter jumps, bookmarks and highlights.

- **Progress memory**: reopening a book returns you to where you left off.
- **Select to translate*
*: highlight any passage and translate it to Chinese in one tap; the model is the one configured in

your host.
- **Ask the book**: an AI assistant grounded in passages retrieved from the open book — s

treamed answers with the cited passages attached.
- **Bilingual UI**: Chinese and English.

## Usage

1. Click 竹居 in the sidebar and import an EPUB, PDF, MOBI/AZW3 or TXT.
2. Open a book to read; the to
p bar switches theme, font size and line height, and the contents panel handles chapter jumps and bo

okmarks.
3. Select text to highlight or translate. The 问书 (ask the book) panel sends your question t
ogether with the relevant passages from the current book.
## Where your data lives
Book files, bookmarks, highlights and reading progress are stored in the browser's IndexedDB. Nothin
g is uploaded to a server.
IndexedDB is scoped per origin, so switching browser or port (another profile, a different `dsh web`
port) starts with an empty bookshelf. That is the browser's security model, not data loss.
When you ask the book a question, only the handful of passages retrieved for that question — never t
he whole book — is sent to the model configured in your host. The host does not store book content.
Without a configured model, the assistant tells you to set one up instead of failing silently.
## Compatibility

- Verified on DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` and `0.2.2-rc.1`, desktop and `web` profile.
- No `engines.dsh` const
raint is declared on purpose: a narrow range makes the host refuse to load the plugin after a DSH up

grade. If your host is older than 0.2.1 the sidebar entry will not appear — upgrade DSH first.
- Sta
ndard Web APIs only: `DecompressionStream` for EPUB, Canvas for PDF, IndexedDB for storage. pdf.js (
Apache-2.0) is inlined into `client.js`, so there are no runtime dependencies.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- No bundler and no installed runtime dependencies: edit the files and they are the artifact. The on
e generated part is the embedded book-format block in `client.js` — after changing `src/` or `vendor

/`, run `node tools/build-formats.mjs` to regenerate it.
- `npm test` runs the suites in `tests/` wi
th Node's built-in test runner (`node --test tests/*.test.js`); it needs no installed dev dependenci

es.
- Install with `link:` into a profile while developing, then restart DSH to pick changes up (hos

t code is loaded into the process; for `client.js`-only changes try a page refresh first).
- The `id
` in `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: 'dsh-tjing-reading', … })` must match the package name, oth
erwise the host cannot resolve the client half.
